description: This file contains implementations for higher-order operations related to PyTorch's dispatch and graph transformation mechanisms, including context managers, tensor redistribution functions, and classes for handling local map higher-order operators with autograd support. It defines custom graph modules, operator hooks, and utility functions for advanced automatic differentiation and parallelization features.

classes.name: LocalMapHOP
classes.description: A custom higher-order operator class for local map operations that integrates with PyTorch's graph system, enabling tracing and transformation for advanced autograd and parallelism.

classes.name: LocalMapAutogradOp
classes.description: A custom autograd Function implementing the backward and forward passes for the local map operation, supporting gradient computation within a traced graph context.

methods.name: tuple[GraphModule,GraphModule,int,int,set[int]] create_hop_fw_bw( fw_gm: GraphModule, *_args: Any, )
methods.description: Creates forward and backward graph modules for a joint, enabling parallel autograd passes with support for fake tensors and partitioning.

methods.description: An autograd function class handling the forward and backward passes of the local map operator with saved state for gradient computation.
